note: written BEFORE any test-seed (8900+) evaluation of IABC-v2 was run
primary_pipeline: IABC-v2b + NOMP + SC tuned (fallback if v2b is not built: IABC-v2a + NOMP + SC tuned); the corrector estimate for (i) is IABC-v2b (fallback v2a)
i: For every impaired test cell with phase >= 8 deg or gain >= 3 dB (ph8, ph20, ph30, ph45, g3, g6, c8_3, c20_4, c30_6) and each impaired component: RMS of the identifiable residual, pooled over all scenes with SNR 5..25 dB, <= 0.5 x RMS before (i.e. >= 75% of the pooled MSE removed). A cell/component counts as INFEASIBLE (not a failure) if the approximate Bayesian bound from d2_crb (crb.json, below) itself removes < 50% of the RMS.
ii: Paper Pd (mean over the 8 SNRs, true L) of the primary pipeline minus NOMP + SC tuned: paired bootstrap (2000, within SNR, seed 0) 95% CI entirely above 0 in at least 5 of the 10 impaired cells (ph5, ph8, ph20, ph30, ph45, g3, g6, c8_3, c20_4, c30_6) AND in no impaired cell entirely below 0.
iii: Official bank (8000, ideal hardware): primary pipeline minus NOMP-only paper Pd, 95% CI upper bound >= 0 (no significant loss). Also reported vs NOMP + SC tuned.
decision: KEEP/REPLACE with IABC-v2 if (i), (ii), (iii) all pass; otherwise recommend dropping IABC from the claims or keeping it as an optional module, with the failing criterion named.
